name: megascenes-anniversary-card
description: Design anniversary cards with your names, the years together, your message and your signature in the design, in the look you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give the names, the years you are celebrating, the main line, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: romantic red roses, elegant gold, watercolor florals, minimal, a funny cartoon. You get an anniversary card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For your partner, your parents' milestone anniversary and friends celebrating theirs.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards or keep a list of dates. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the names, years, message and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A romantic anniversary card with red roses for Giulia & Marco, 10 years together
An elegant gold card for my parents' 40th anniversary, signed Love, Anna
A funny cartoon anniversary card that says Ten years and you still laugh at my jokes

positive.prompt: A romantic anniversary card with red roses for Giulia & Marco, 10 years together. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one anniversary card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An elegant gold card for my parents' 40th anniversary, signed Love, Anna. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design an anniversary card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The anniversary card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A funny cartoon anniversary card, square, with the words Ten years and you still laugh at my jokes. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my anniversary card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my anniversary card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
